Topic.label: Problems Involving Angles of Elevation, Angles of Depression, and Bearings

Question: Ports \(A\) and \(B\) are 20 nautical miles apart, with \(A\) due west of \(B\). Lighthouse \(C\) is \(45^\circ\) east of north from \(A\) and \(45^\circ\) west of north from \(B\). Find the distance from lighthouse \(C\) to line \(AB\). (Unit: nautical miles)
Solution: Draw \(CD\perp AB\) at \(D\). Then \(\angle CAD=\angle CBD=45^\circ\), \(AD=CD\), and \(BD=CD\). Therefore, \(2CD=20\), so \(CD=10\).
